description_en: Retrieves basic information about a specified image, such as the file name, format, size, and resolution
description_zh: 获取指定图片的文件名、格式、大小和分辨率等基本信息
name: DetectImageBasicInfo

parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. Only HTTP/HTTPS protocols are supported. Specify either `ImageUrl` or `ObjectKey`. At least one of them is required
parameters.help_zh: 图片的 URL 地址，仅支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议。`ImageUrl` 与 `ObjectKey` 二选一，至少提供一个
parameters.name: image_url

schema.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

Code.description_en: The business error code. Returns "OK" when the request succeeds
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 "OK"

Dpi.description_en: The image resolution (width × height), such as 1920 × 1080. Empty if the resolution cannot be identified
Dpi.description_zh: 图片分辨率（宽 * 高），如 1920 * 1080。无法识别时为空

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. Returns 200 when the request succeeds
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 200

Message.description_en: The additional information. Returns "success" when the request succeeds
Message.description_zh: 附加信息。请求成功时返回 "success"

Size.description_en: The file size in a human-readable format, such as 1.5 MB or 256 KB
Size.description_zh: 文件大小（人类可读格式），如 1.5 MB、256 KB

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

Type.description_en: The image format, such as JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WEBP. Returns `UNKNOWN` if the format cannot be identified
Type.description_zh: 图片格式，如 JPEG、PNG、GIF、WEBP 等。无法识别时返回 `UNKNOWN`
